instruction: Extract all text content from the Impress presentation and compile it into a Word document named "content.docx" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting all text from PowerPoint presentation to Word document. Evaluator verifies multiple aspects: (1) paragraph count in tight range (45-50) based on ground truth of 47 paragraphs, (2) word count between 800-1500, (3) minimum character count of 4000, and (4) presence of key phrases from the presentation (ChatGPT, artificial intelligence, language model, natural language). This multi-faceted verification ensures actual content extraction rather than arbitrary paragraph creation.

llm_judge_reasons: Comprehensive multi-faceted verification: Evaluator checks paragraph count (45-50), word count (800-1500), character count (4000+), and key phrase presence
Semantic content verification: Key phrases (ChatGPT, artificial intelligence, language model, natural language) verify actual content extraction from the presentation
Appropriate expected values: Paragraph range 45-50 is tight (5-paragraph tolerance) based on ground truth of 47 paragraphs
Correct parameter handling: Metric function properly receives rules dict directly from get_rule() and accesses keys without incorrect nested access patterns
Proper postconfig: Activates content.docx window and saves file before verification to ensure state accessibility
Sound evaluation logic: Returns 1.0 only if ALL checks pass (paragraph count, word count, char count, key phrases), preventing false positives from random text
